introText:
Not sure where to start with preparing your workforce for future project opportunities and business growth?

This assessment helps you understand whether you have the right people, skills and plans in place to support future business growth and project opportunities.

By completing this assessment, you can:

  • Assess your current workforce capability, capacity and workforce risks
  • Identify workforce strengths and areas for improvement
  • Receive recommendations and practical next steps
  • Access workforce support services, resources and funding opportunities
  • Develop a Workforce Action Plan using the Workforce Action Plan template

How to answer

Answer each question based on your current business practices. If you're unsure, select the option that best reflects your business today. The recommendations will help you identify practical actions to strengthen your workforce over time.

Time required

Approximately 45 minutes total
5-10 minutes per topic.

Your progress will be saved to your current device, allowing you to return and complete the assessment later if you open the questionnaire in the same browser.

Need support?

You can reach out to a Territory Business Advisor on 1800 193 111.

You may also be interested in our Business Safety and Security Checklist or Business Health Checklist, which explore broader business capability, risk management and operational readiness.

Privacy

We value your privacy and your responses are confidential. Your data will be stored on your own device and will not be accessible to the Northern Territory Government, unless you choose to share your results with a Territory Business Advisor.

Disclaimer

Laws and regulations can change over time. While we aim to provide accurate guidance and point you to helpful resources, it's important to check whether the information is suitable for your specific situation.

Every business is different, so please ensure any advice or material you use is appropriate for your circumstances before making decisions or taking action.
finalSummary:
Well done in completing this Workforce Readiness Checklist.

Understanding your workforce strengths and risks is an important step in preparing your business for future projects and growth opportunities.

Trying to change or improve everything at once will be difficult. To help:

  • Access the available Workforce Action Plan template
  • Prioritise a small number of workforce actions
  • Focus on high-risk workforce gaps
  • Review workforce readiness regularly
  • Engage with industry, training providers, and workforce partners early

You may also consider engaging a workforce consultant and/or seeking funding support through the Business Growth Program.

Would you like to speak to a Territory Business Advisor to discuss your results and next steps? Contact a Territory Business Advisor on 1800 193 111.
